claim: In 30 subjects each studied in a vehicle session and in a drug session, the drug raises muscle force: the mean paired difference in force between the drug and the vehicle session, adjusted for the muscle cross-sectional area measured in each session by analysis of covariance, is positive with a two-sided p-value below 0.05.

data_keys.meaning: peak voluntary knee-extension force of each subject in the vehicle session, in N
peak voluntary knee-extension force of each subject in the drug session, in N
quadriceps cross-sectional area of each subject measured in the vehicle session, in cm2
quadriceps cross-sectional area of each subject measured in the drug session, in cm2
